ARKHAM DEPOT
If arriving in Arkham, go to any Arkham Location.
If heading to Boston, trains leave at 9am, noon, 
and 5pm. The trip takes an hour. You may wait for 
your train (on arrival in Boston, go to 64), or go to 
any other Arkham Location. 
(Arkham Location)
